title: Puharich's assistant says he created the UFO experience with flashing lights

tellings.quote: using flashing lights, using all all all of that stuff was able to create the the the UFO experience. That that stuff was all created, she says.

plain: A former assistant to Andrija Puharich, a doctor who studied psychic phenomena, says Puharich used flashing lights and similar tricks to create "the UFO experience" for the people around him: "That stuff was all created, she says." An unnamed researcher on the podcast passes this on from a tape recording made around 1994 by the writer Dick Russell. If true, it would mean some of the contact experiences tied to Puharich were staged.
